sloka: लब्ध्वा पुनस्त्वं वैदेहीं किमर्थं सम्प्रजल्पसि।यदीच्छसि तदा सीता वशगा ते भविष्यति ।। ६.६४.२० ।।
transliteration: labdhvā punastvaṁ vaidehīṁ kimarthaṁ samprajalpasi।yadīcchasi tadā sītā vaśagā te bhaviṣyati ।। 6.64.20 ।।

translations.english: "Having got Vaidehi, why are you talking like that? Sita will submit to you if you desire."
